collection.title: Dacia Jogger 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description:
The Dacia Jogger is fitted with specific fit wiper blades on the front windscreen and a plastic moulded wiper for the rear screen. We supply wiper blades manufactured to the highest quality, by the leading brand names, designed to fit the Dacia Jogger range of vehicles including: Bosch - Aerotwin & Super Plus, Michelin - Stealth & RainForce, Lucas - Clearvision and our own award winning Aerowiper. Over 400 different windscreen wiper products held in stock - the largest selection of front and rear screen wiper blades - available from the UK's online Wiper Blade Specialist.

Dacia Jogger Windshield Wiper Fitting Guide:

The Dacia Jogger uses 24” driver’s side, 16” passenger’s side & a 9” plastic moulded rear screen wiper blade which has a specific fitting. Dacia Jogger window wipers are easy to replace and all our wiper blades come with fitting instructions. We also provide a link to a handy fitting video with your order.
